sources.facts: Owner guide identifies the standing Gedung Induk, front porch with large glazed windbreak panels and generous rear veranda, teak, metal and concrete fabric, and combined European summer house and tropical West Java architecture.
National cultural register identifies the palace in Cipanas, West Java.
Public government account records the front floor raised about two metres, with large glazed sides and the longer rear veranda facing the mountains.
State news interview with palace guide Anisa records eleven steps at the front veranda and lead-framed stained glass on both sides. Consulted text only.
